observations:
Torah #10 yields 4 packages that map cleanly onto the Torah's four-part argument. No new independent bechina-cluster exists that falls outside these four packages.

The teaching's structure:
  Package 2 (Tzaddik/Ruach) → eitza → Package 1 (Hands/Feet, revealed) → eitza → Package 4 (Prayer/Bayit, the goal) → eitza → Package 3 (Pride/AZ, the obstacle, which is defeated)

The good/evil mirror is present and correctly identified:
  Package 1 (ידים ורגלים — good, rectified limbs) mirrors the evil-limb concepts in Package 3 (מינות = 'natavu raglai' = fallen feet; חרון אף = the smoke from the nostrils when feet are wrong).
  Package 2 (צדיק — good) mirrors implicitly the ba'al gaavah who falsely claims tzaddik-status (Avimeleich), but this false tzaddik is folded into Package 3's evil domain.

Korach-section (section tet) — the extended midrashic narrative about Korach does NOT form a new independent cluster. All its concepts map back to existing packages: Korach = minut = avodah zarah (Package 3); the lance/mem/four-winds = ruach of the tzaddik (Package 2); the wool/omer = Mordechai/hands (Package 1). The Korach aggadah is an illustrative elaboration of the main bechina-structure, not a new conceptual domain.

Note on total count: Torah #10 has 46 bechina edges (some with null IDs indicating provisional/unnumbered entries), yielding 51 unique nodes across 4 packages. This is comparable in density to Torah #1 (48 bechina edges, 49 nodes, 5 packages). The fewer packages here reflect that Torah #10 is more tightly organized around a single central axis (ידים/רגלים) with its tzaddik-cause and pride-opposition.
